data_description.update_interval: How often to fetch data from Google (30-3600 seconds)
data_description.enable_location_tracking: When enabled, each location poll may send a notification to the child's device
data_description.strict_mode: Strict mode closes a gap on Google's side that many children know how to use: from the Family Link app or the Google interface, a supervised child can give themselves a time bonus, unlock a device that has no time left, or switch bedtime and the daily limit off. With strict mode on, Home Assistant becomes the single point of control: after every refresh it reverts those changes and overrides the Family Link settings with what you set from Home Assistant. WARNING: while it is on, manage Family Link from Home Assistant only, changes made in the Family Link app are undone. Turn the child's Strict Mode switch off to hand control back to Google. The child's Strict Mode switch mirrors this option: changing one updates the other.
data_description.strict_mode_rules: What strict mode enforces. Nothing is switched on by force: the state chosen in Home Assistant is the reference. Details in the README.
data_description.lock_keeps_allowed_apps: When on, a device locked from Home Assistant still lets the child open the apps marked "always allowed" in Family Link, through an "Available apps" button on the lock screen (what the Family Link app does when its lock screen setting is on). Switch off for a plain lock: emergency calls only.
data_description.allowed_users: Leave empty to let every Home Assistant user use the Family Link buttons, switches and settings (the default). Once you tick users here, only they and the administrators can: a child's non-administrator account is refused on every Family Link button, switch, limit, time and select, and on the familylink.* actions. Automations and scripts started by Home Assistant itself are not affected. Give the child a non-administrator account: an administrator can change this option.

manual_url.title: Authentication Server URL
manual_url.description:
No local authentication source was detected. Enter the Family Link Auth server base URL. Any reverse-proxy path prefix is preserved. If the standalone container has API_KEY configured, enter it separately; otherwise leave the key blank.

URL example: `http://192.168.1.100:8099`

set_app_daily_limit.description: Set a daily time limit for a specific app. Use -2 for unlimited time (ignores device limits). Use -1 to disable app limit (follows device limits). Use 0 for completely blocked. Needs a child (entity or child_id), or all_children: true for every supervised child.

pause_app.name: Pause App
pause_app.description: Pause apps for one child by setting their daily limit to 1 minute. The app stays installed (blocking hides it, and a blocked Google Messages loses incoming texts). An app already used today pauses at once; an app not used yet gets its 1 minute first. The previous setting is saved and resume_app puts it back. Does nothing on Google TV, which ignores app limits. A child is required.

resume_app.name: Resume App
resume_app.description: Put back the daily limit setting that apps had before pause_app (a limit, unlimited time, or no limit). An app whose setting a parent changed in the Family Link app since the pause keeps that setting. Apps that pause_app did not pause are left alone, and so is an app blocked since the pause (its saved setting is kept for when it is unblocked). A child is required.

packages.name: Packages
packages.description: Android package names to resume. Leave empty to resume every app paused for the child.

set_school_time.name: Set School Time
set_school_time.description: Set the School Time start and finish for a day. By default this edits the recurring WEEKLY school time slot of that day (the day must already have a school time window in Family Link). Use scope "today" for a one-off override of today's school time that leaves the weekly schedule unchanged. If no day is specified, applies to today. For a school day with a break, give every window of the day in "windows" instead of a start and an end.

end_time.name: End Time
end_time.description: School time end, same day and after the start (e.g., 13:15). Not with "windows".

windows.name: Windows
windows.description: Every window of the day in order, "HH:MM-HH:MM" each, for a school day with a break (e.g. 08:00-12:00 and 13:30-15:00), the same list as the windows attribute of the school time entities. Two windows on a day that has one add the break, one window on a day that has two removes it (Family Link allows one break per day). Replaces start and end. Weekly scope only; the day must have school time in Family Link.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Switch the day's school time on or off in the weekly schedule, keeping its hours (the checkbox of the day in the Family Link weekly editor). On its own, without start, end or windows. Weekly scope only.

day.name: Day
day.description: Day of the week. If not specified, applies to today.

scope.name: Scope
scope.description: "weekly" (default) edits the recurring weekly school time slot of the day. "today" posts a one-off school time window for today only.

set_filter_level.description: Switch the child's Chrome web filter between the approved sites only (the allow list) and every site with Google's explicit-content filter, as under 'Google Chrome and Web' in the Family Link app. Applies to the child's Google account, so to every Chrome the child is signed in to.

sync_site_list.name: Sync Site List
sync_site_list.description: Keep the child's blocked sites in step with a published list of domains (one per line, '#' comments). Adds what the list gained, removes only what this list added before and has since dropped; entries made by hand and approved sites are left alone. The list comes from a third party, so it must be served over https, is read up to 1 MiB, and only plain domains are taken (wildcards, web addresses, IP addresses and bare suffixes such as co.uk are ignored). An answer with no usable domain, or one that would remove most of what the list added, is refused; stop removes everything the list added. Administrators only.

stop.name: Stop Syncing
